code.title: allenai/OLMo-core
code.note: the second-generation pretraining code (Apache 2.0; repo, about 20 minutes for the README and entry path). Post-training is open-instruct and evaluation is OLMES, both Apache 2.0, listed below

takeaway: Fully open 7B/13B/32B recipe: stability fixes (normal init, post-norm+QK-norm, z-loss), Dolmino mid-training anneal with microanneals and souping, Tulu 3 RLVR; Pareto-frontier vs open-weights peers.
verdict: Believe the recipe: every stability fix comes with a before-and-after curve, each one reproduces in direction when its spike score is recounted from the paper's own vector figures, and the models, data, code and logs are public to check. Read the margins as single-run results: no seeds, data choices made on 200 GSM8K questions (about ±3.4 points each), and several tables that disagree with each other or with the text.
